test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 3 years at 8% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Time (T) = 3 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 8% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T)) / 100

**Calculation:**

Let Principal (P) be ₹x

Using the formula:

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

⇒ 240 = (x × 8 × 3) / 100

⇒ 240 = 24x / 100

⇒ 240 × 100 = 24x

⇒ 24000 = 24x

⇒ x = 24000 / 24

⇒ x = 1000

**The principal sum is ₹1000.**
